name: uper-10-to-uper-label-with-control-character
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.19 (ASN.1 unaligned PER): label "a" and U+0001: codes below 32 are written as they are (ascii on chars does not check printable characters): count 1 in 3 bits, 1100001, 0000001. 127 bits, padded to 16 octets. Derived without an engine by a standalone X.691 reference program (Python standard library) and checked against two independent ASN.1 UPER codecs on the ASN.1 module in the pack header: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper; asn1tools checks y (INTEGER (-5..MAX)) only as a length and octets, because it encodes a semi-constrained integer as an unconstrained one, which X.691 does not.
